pr.title: Chapter 11: core data elements (CDE-HRH) plus NHWA module extension sets
pr.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"litlfred"} -->
_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9WwtQiEUvdGPQ4efY1dCDAo)_

Builds on #93 (merged). Refs #53 (CS-001). Staging: https://litlfred.github.io/dth-hrh/STAGING/claude-dth-hrh-cde-nhwa/

## What

Chapter 11 becomes one core data element set (CDE-HRH) that every registry holds, plus one extension set per module of the NHWA handbook, 2nd edition (who-iris `library/9789240081291-eng`).

| Section | Label | Elements |
|---|---|---|
| 11.1 Core data elements (CDE-HRH) | `sec:11-1` | the 10 working elements from #93, plus **sex** and **occupation** |
| 11.2 NHWA Module 1: Stock and flow | `sec:11-2` | activity level, subnational unit of practice, facility ownership, facility type, place of training, date of entry, date and type of exit, type of contract |
| 11.3 NHWA Module 2: Education | `sec:11-3` | qualification and programme; training institution and year of graduation |
| 11.4 NHWA Module 3: Finance and expenditures | `sec:11-4` | employer sector; salary grade at entry (optional) |
| 11.5 NHWA Module 4: Working conditions, governance and leadership | `sec:11-5` | leadership position (optional) |
| 11.6 Classifications, 11.7 Metadata, 11.8 NHWA mapping | `sec:11-6..8` | unchanged blocks, renumbered |

- Labels: `de:mds-*` → `de:cde-*`; new elements `de:nhwa-mN-*`. Clean break, no forwarding.
- `meta.elementSet` (`cde`, `nhwa-m1`..`nhwa-m4`) and `meta.supportsIndicators` (NHWA codes) on every element. New elements cite the who-iris NHWA indicator sections they come from.
- New element definitions stay *to draft*: the working group writes them. Only category lists quoted from the NHWA handbook are filled in (for example activity level: practising, professionally active, licensed to practise).
- Each module section opens with a short block saying which indicators name a registry as a data source and which come from other sources.
- `.jsonld` siblings and `review-anchors.json` regenerated.

- Each section opens with an at-a-glance table: element, NHWA indicators, categories the handbook names, definition status.

## Glossary

New scheme `glossary/dth-hrh-data-elements.glossary.json`: one candidate term for each of the 25 data elements, linked from each block's `meta.glossary`.

- 10 terms quote the NHWA handbook, 2nd edition, glossary as a **provisional definition** (`editorialNote`), `closeMatch` to the who-iris `nhwa-2023` concept (Q-GLD-1 A, Q-GLD-2 A).
- 15 terms say **Definition to draft**.
- `related`: matching TWG (dth-hrh) terms and partial NHWA concepts. No links to the 2015 MDS (Q-GLD-3 C).

The 2015 MDS is not cited anywhere in this PR.
